subject: maths
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: A right-angled triangle has legs 5 and 12. What is the hypotenuse?
Convert 3.5 m^2 into cm^2.
What is the exact value of cos 30°?
questions.explain: cos 30° = √3/2 is a standard exact value.

questions.q: How many degrees does each interior angle of a regular pentagon measure?
questions.explain: Interior sum = (5 - 2) x 180 = 540 deg, and 540 / 5 = 108 deg.

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
questions.explain: A square has 4 lines of symmetry.

questions.q: A line that touches a circle at exactly one point is called a:
questions.explain: A tangent meets the circle at exactly one point.

questions.q: What is the value of tan 45°?
questions.explain: tan 45° = 1 since opposite equals adjacent.

questions.q: Three angles meet at a point and are 120°, 150° and x. What is x?
questions.explain: Angles around a point sum to 360°, so x = 360° − 120° − 150° = 90°.

questions.q: A right-angled triangle has hypotenuse 13 cm and one shorter side 5 cm. What is the other side?
Convert 4000 cm^3 into litres.
questions.explain: 1 litre = 1000 cm^3, so 4000 / 1000 = 4 litres.

questions.q: Three angles of a quadrilateral are 90°, 100° and 80°. What is the fourth angle?
questions.explain: Angles in a quadrilateral sum to 360°, so 360° − 90° − 100° − 80° = 90°.

questions.q: A right-angled triangle has hypotenuse 10 and an angle of 30°. The opposite side equals 10 × sin 30°. What is its length?
A triangular prism has a triangular cross-section of area 15 cm^2 and length 9 cm. What is its volume?
questions.explain: Volume = cross-sectional area x length = 15 x 9 = 135 cm^3.

questions.q: Two parallel lines are crossed by a transversal. One angle is 112 deg. What is its corresponding angle?
questions.explain: Corresponding (F) angles are equal, so it is 112 deg.

questions.q: An equilateral triangle has all sides equal. What is the size of each interior angle?
questions.explain: Angles sum to 180 deg and all three are equal, so each is 180 / 3 = 60 deg.

questions.q: Two triangles are similar with a scale factor of 3. A side of 4 cm on the small triangle matches which side on the large one?
questions.explain: Multiply by the scale factor: 4 x 3 = 12 cm.

questions.q: A cylinder has radius 3 cm and height 10 cm. What is its volume? (Use π ≈ 3.14)
questions.explain: Volume = πr^2h = π × 9 × 10 ≈ 282.6 cm^3.

questions.q: You are facing due North then turn clockwise to face due East. What is this bearing?
questions.explain: East corresponds to a bearing of 090° measured clockwise from North.

questions.q: Convert 2500 mm into metres.
A cuboid measures 4 cm by 3 cm by 5 cm. What is its volume?
questions.explain: Volume = 4 × 3 × 5 = 60 cm^3.

questions.q: In a right-angled triangle, which ratio equals the opposite divided by the hypotenuse?
questions.explain: By SOHCAHTOA, sin = opposite ÷ hypotenuse.

questions.q: A square has a perimeter of 36 cm. What is its area?
questions.explain: Side = 36 / 4 = 9 cm, so area = 9 x 9 = 81 cm^2.
